title.en: Iran launches attacks on American military facilities in Bahrain and Kuwait after fresh US strikes – Middle East crisis live
title.zh: 美国发动新一轮袭击后，伊朗对美国在巴林和科威特的军事设施发动袭击——中东危机直播

body.en: The fire is one of the deadliest such incidents in the popular tourist destination in ⁠recent years An explosive fire at a popular pub in Thailand’s ⁠capital, Bangkok, has killed 27 ⁠people and left another 22 ​in critical condition, in one of the deadliest such incidents in the tourism hub in recent years. Officials said they were investigating whether emergency exits may have been obstructed, hindering patrons from escaping the burning Rong Beer Na Lat Phrao pub. Continue reading...

It reminds us that suffering is not the final word, and a future free from pain awaits.

verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

body.en:

The former partner of a woman whose body was found near Toowoomba at the weekend has appeared in court for the first time after being charged with her murder .

Sam Neill , the versatile New Zealand actor whose career spanned Oscar winners and blockbusters such as The Piano and Jurassic Park, has died aged 78 .

An academic at UNSW was subjected to Nazi salutes by students in his business class , the royal commission into antisemitism and social cohesion has heard.

The Albanese government has announced it will roll out digital passenger cards to all Australian international airports and seaports after a “successful” trial on Qantas flights into Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne.

The federal government has been accused of exploiting international students and permanent residents after non-refundable visa fees were quietly hiked by up to 200% , placing Australia well in excess of other western countries.

title.en: Renewed US-Iran war is hitting Gulf countries hard
title.zh: 美伊战火重燃，海湾国家遭受重创

summary.en: Following US strikes on Iran, Iran has targeted US allies in the Middle East. Gulf countries face significant losses as the fighting escalates, despite not being directly targeted by Iran's governments or populations.
summary.zh: 在美国对伊朗发动袭击后，伊朗已将目标对准了美国在中东的盟友。尽管伊朗并未直接针对其邻国的政府或民众，但随着战事升级，海湾国家将蒙受巨大损失。

body.en:
After US strikes on Iran, Iran has targeted US allies in the Middle East. Even if Iran isn't targeting the governments or populations of its neighbors, Gulf countries have much to lose as fighting escalates.

Yet again, countries in the Gulf region find themselves on the front line between the United States and Iran.

The war began in late February when the US and Israel attacked Iran. A memorandum of understanding intended to stop the fighting was signed by the US and Iran in June. Since then, however, both countries have accused the other of not adhering to the agreement, and fighting has started again. The US has bombed Iran, and Iran has retaliated by striking US allies in the Middle East — that is, mostly Gulf nations. 

Even if they are not hit directly, all countries in the Gulf region have something to lose should fighting escalate again.

Bahrain is home to a major US Navy base. The recent strikes by Iran saw the country hit directly.

As Bahrain is among the smaller Gulf countries, US military installations tend to be closer to residential and commercial areas than in its neighbors. Even limited fighting disrupts civilian life.

Politically, Bahrain is in a particularly difficult position. Like other Gulf countries , Bahrain is a monarchy and represses most political dissent. But, in contrast to other Gulf countries, Bahrain's royal family are Sunni. Estimates suggest that the majority of the population is Shiite. 

Iran is a Shiite theocracy. Ongoing fighting between Iran and the United States could create tensions within Bahrain, where the government has arrested hundreds of people who allegedly posted anti-war messages online, expressed "sympathy" with Iran or participated in demonstrations, or who the government claims were "spies" working for Iran.

Kuwait hosts the largest number of US bases in the Middle East. This includes two air bases and about 13,500 personnel, including contractors. This has made Kuwait a target for Iranian strikes.

Previously, Kuwait was more cautious with its foreign policy, often positioning itself as a mediator and emphasizing that it did not want to play a role in the current conflict. Iraq's 1990 invasion was a factor in shaping Kuwait's foreign policy, which is far less activist than those of its neighbors. However, the fact that Iran has attacked Kuwait because of its US bases is likely to cause this attitude to evolve. Observers have already noted that the Kuwait government's protests about Iranian strikes have become more forthright.

After years of competing with Iran for regional influence, Saudi Arabia has stressed that diplomacy must be the answer if Gulf countries are to coexist in relative peace.

body.zh: 美国打击伊朗后，伊朗又将目标瞄准了美国在中东的盟友。即使伊朗不针对其邻国政府或民众，随着战斗升级，海湾国家也会遭受很大损失。 海湾地区国家再次发现自己处于美国和伊朗之间的前线。 战争于二月底开始，当时美国和以色列袭击了伊朗。美国和伊朗于六月签署了一份旨在停止战斗的谅解备忘录。然而，此后两国都指责对方不遵守协议，战斗再次开始。美国轰炸了伊朗，伊朗也通过打击美国在中东的盟友（主要是海湾国家）进行报复。 即使没有受到直接打击，如果战事再次升级，海湾地区所有国家都会有损失。 巴林是美国主要海军基地的所在地。伊朗最近的袭击对该国造成了直接打击。 由于巴林是较小的海湾国家之一，美国的军事设施往往比其邻国更靠近住宅和商业区。即使是有限的战斗也会扰乱平民的生活。 在政治上，巴林处于特别困难的境地。与其他海湾国家一样，巴林是君主制国家，镇压大多数政治异议。但是，与其他海湾国家不同的是，巴林王室是逊尼派。据估计，大多数人口是什叶派。 伊朗是什叶派神权国家。伊朗和美国之间持续不断的战斗可能会在巴林境内造成紧张局势，巴林政府逮捕了数百名据称在网上发布反战信息、对伊朗表示“同情”或参加示威活动的人，或者政府声称这些人是为伊朗工作的“间谍”。 科威特拥有中东地区数量最多的美国基地。其中包括两个空军基地和约 13,500 名人员，其中包括承包商。这使得科威特成为伊朗袭击的目标。 此前，科威特对外政策较为谨慎，经常将自己定位为调解者，并强调不想在当前冲突中发挥作用。 1990 年伊拉克的入侵是影响科威特外交政策的一个因素，科威特的外交政策远没有其邻国那么积极。 然而，伊朗因为美国基地而袭击科威特这一事实很可能会导致这种态度的演变。 观察人士已经注意到，科威特政府对伊朗袭击的抗议变得更加直率。 经过多年与伊朗争夺地区影响力后，沙特阿拉伯强调，如果海湾国家想要相对和平共处，外交就必须是答案。 和...

reflection.en: The escalating conflict between major powers inevitably creates hardship for neighboring nations, even those not directly targeted. This situation reminds us of the biblical call to pursue peace with all people, as far as it depends on us. When this pursuit falters, the ripple effects of instability and suffering extend far beyond the immediate combatants.
reflection.zh: 主要大国之间不断升级的冲突，即使没有直接针对邻国，也必然给它们带来苦难。这种情况提醒我们，圣经呼吁我们尽力与所有人和平相处。当这种追求动摇时，不稳定和苦难的涟漪效应会远远超出直接的交战方。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: The SpaceX IPO made history. One month on has it lost momentum?
title.zh: SpaceX首次公开募股创造了历史。兴奋感还在吗？

summary.en: A month after SpaceX's stock market debut, the practicalities of how the firm generates revenue have become clearer, prompting reflection on the initial excitement.
summary.zh: SpaceX公司首次公开募股（IPO）一个月后，该公司目前如何盈利的现实似乎变得更加清晰，引发了人们对最初兴奋感的反思。

body.en:
SpaceX investors have swung from celebration to apparent concern in its first month as a publicly traded company.

When shares in the firm, co-founded and led by Elon Musk, first became available for individuals to buy on the public stock market on 12 June, there was an investor frenzy .

Although the company had decided to price its shares at $135 each, the price immediately shot up to $150 that first day, climbing to $176, before closing at $160.95.

The following week, its shares went up even further, hitting an intraday high of $225, meaning it had surpassed Amazon and Microsoft in total market value.

"With Elon Musk, any company he touches gets people excited," Keith Snyder, analyst at investment research firm CFRA, said. "But this was also the first time people felt like they were able to invest in something that was being marketed as an AI play."

Willy Lee, an investor at Neosteller, which facilitates individual investors putting money into private companies, agreed that the excitement around the IPO was very much around artificial intelligence (AI).

SpaceX earlier this year acquired Musk's AI start-up xAI, recently renamed SpaceXAI , external and best known for the controversial chatbot Grok, and also started leasing data centre capacity to other tech companies.

But its main business is the manufacture and launch of rockets and telecommunications satellites called Starlink. When Starlink said it was cutting prices in the Memphis, Tennessee area amid local concerns over a massive data centre project, SpaceX shares fell on the day by 8%.

As the reality of how SpaceX currently makes money has seemed to come into clearer focus, the company's shares have started to sink.

Even amid a tumultuous couple of weeks for tech stocks , SpaceX has taken a particular hit.

When it was added to the Nasdaq100 index on 7 July, for instance, although the index closed down 1.7%, SpaceX fell 4.4%. An earlier addition to the FTSE Russell index had given the shares a slight boost.

At the end of its first trading month, shares of SpaceX were selling at around $145 each, roughly 18% less than the high on its first day of trading, and 35% less than its peak so far.

Such a drop in price means that retail investors who purchased SpaceX stock during its first five days of trading are looking at a potential loss on their investment.

"If you bought around the first tick you're definitely underwater," Snyder said.

"It started to look a lot like a meme stock," Snyder added, pointing to the examples of GameStop and, more recently, Wendy's , external , where retail investors drive up a stock price through little more than excited online conversation.

title.en: Fighting escalates as Iran and US jostle for control of Strait of Hormuz
title.zh: 伊朗和美国争夺霍尔木兹海峡控制权，战事升级

summary.en: The number of ships crossing the Strait of Hormuz has fallen amid escalating conflict between Iran and the US, as the UN warns of potentially catastrophic consequences.

body.en:
Fighting between the United States and Iran continued on Monday as both nations claimed authority over the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz following a weekend of military strikes across the Middle East.

The latest violence was triggered after Iran struck a container ship in the strait off the coast of Oman at the weekend, raising fears that diplomatic efforts to end the conflict are collapsing.

In response, the US military's Central Command (CENTCOM) launched a new wave of attacks targeting dozens of Iranian military sites, including air defence systems, radar installations, missile and drone facilities, and small naval vessels.

US officials said the strikes followed an even larger operation on Sunday that hit around 140 targets.

Iran retaliated by launching attacks against countries hosting US military forces, including Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Jordan and Oman. Tehran continues to insist it has the right to control shipping through the strait.

As violence intensifies, international mediators are pressing for renewed negotiations, with United Nations secretary-general António Guterres warning that a return to full-scale hostilities would have "catastrophic consequences".

Control of the strategic waterway has become key leverage for Iran, with an adviser to the country's supreme leader on Sunday saying it was more important than "dozens of atomic bombs".

Iran's Revolutionary Guards said "the Strait of Hormuz will be closed until further notice and until the end of American interventions in this region", according to state news agency IRNA.

US CENTCOM countered on X that the strait was "open to all vessels seeking to lawfully transit".

Only six vessels transited the strait on Sunday, ship-tracking data from Kpler showed, the lowest number in five weeks.

On Sunday evening, Iranian state media reported at least 10 "enemy projectiles" hitting Qeshm Island, which sits on the Strait of Hormuz.

It reported further strikes on the island of Farur, to the east of Qeshm in the Gulf, that it said killed a telecommunications worker and wounded two others.

IRNA also reported early on Monday morning that US strikes had killed one person and wounded four at a water pumping station in the southwest city of Mahshahr.

Oman's government summoned the Iranian ambassador and handed him a formal protest — a rare move for the sultanate, which has been seeking to balance competing demands from the US and Iran.

The attack came just hours after the country hosted Iran's foreign minister to discuss the Strait of Hormuz.

title.en: EU set to approve air travel passenger rights package
title.zh: 欧盟将批准航空旅客权利一揽子计划

summary.en: EU ministers are expected to approve a set of reforms giving more rights to air travelers. Among other things, compensation claims are to be made easier.
summary.zh: 欧盟部长们预计将批准一系列改革，赋予航空旅客更多权利。其中包括，索赔将变得更加容易。

body.en:
EU ministers are expected to approve a set of reforms giving more rights to air travelers. Among other things, compensation claims are to be made easier.

A package of reforms granting additional rights to air passengers was formally approved by the Council of the European Union on Monday.

The reforms, which have already been greenlighted by the European Parliament, will apply to all departures from airports in the bloc and to arrivals if operated by an EU-based airline.

Rules on passenger compensation in the case of delayed or canceled flights are to remain largely unchanged, with passengers still entitled to some refund if a flight is at least three hours late and the airline is at fault.

Under the rules, airlines will not be considered responsible for incidents involving unruly passengers , weather conditions, natural disasters or strikes by airport or ground-handling staff.

However, compensation claims are to be made easier and passenger rights in the case of disruption to their travel will be clarified.

title.en: Sam Neill, Jurassic Park actor, dies 'unexpectedly' at 78
title.zh: 《侏罗纪公园》演员萨姆·尼尔“意外”去世，享年78岁

summary.en: New Zealand actor Sam Neill, widely known for his role as Dr. Alan Grant in the 1993 film Jurassic Park, has died at the age of 78. His extensive career also included numerous other notable appearances in television and film.

body.en:
New Zealand actor Sam Neill achieved international fame playing Dr. Alan Grant in the 1993 film Jurassic Park. But his career included many other notable TV and film appearances.

The New Zealand  actor rose to international prominence for his performance as Dr. Alan Grant in the 1993 film Jurassic Park .

"The loss ‌was sudden and ‌unexpected ​but blessed by the fact that Sam remained ​cancer free," a statement posted ⁠on ​Neill's Instagram ​page said, referring to his diagnosis with blood cancer announced in 2023.

Neill's acting career was launched in the 1970s, with his role in Gillian Armstrong's 1979 film My Brilliant Career  already making his name known internationally.

He played a multitude of other TV and film roles, including the British historical crime drama Peaky Blinders , the US spy thriller  The Hunt for Red October  and Jane Campion's  The Piano , which won the highest award in Cannes in 1993.

But it was his role in Jurassic Park  as the paleontologist Grant, where he played alongside Laura Dern, Jeff Goldblum and Richard Attenborough, that cemented his international standing.

 As a sideline to his acting, Neill also ran vineyards in the Central Otago region of New Zealand's South Island.

In 2023, Neill announced he had been diagnosed with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, a rare type of non-Hodgkin lymphoma, but said in April this year that a scan had detected no cancer in his body following treatment.

He told the British newspaper The Guardian in 2023 that he could not "pretend that the last year hasn’t had its dark moments." 

"But those dark moments throw the light into sharp relief, you know, and have made me grateful for every day and immensely grateful for all my friends," he said.

Neill, who was born in 1947 in Omagh, Northern Ireland, to an English mother and a New Zealand father, moved to New Zealand with his family in 1954, growing up in Christchurch.

Homages have been pouring in from politicians and acting colleagues following the news of Neill's death.

New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon described the actor in a social media post as "one of the greats" and a mainstay of his country's film industry.

"He started out when there was barely a film ‌industry ​in this country to speak of," Luxon wrote.

"For more than fifty years he took New Zealand stories to the world and his talents helped ​make our film industry into what it is today — one of our greatest cultural exports," he added.

Anthony Albanese, the prime minister of Australia, where Neill was a household name, said the late actor would be "much mourned and long remembered."

The Australian actor Magda Szubanski also voiced her shock at the news.

title.zh: 泰国媒体报道曼谷酒吧火灾造成至少27人死亡

summary.en: Thai media reports indicate at least 27 people were killed in a bar fire in Bangkok, with unverified footage showing flames erupting as people fled.
summary.zh: 泰国媒体报道称，曼谷一家酒吧发生火灾，造成至少27人死亡。未经证实的视频显示，人们逃离时火焰从酒吧内喷出。

body.en:
A huge fire tore through a bar in Bangkok late on Sunday, killing at least 27 people and leaving 22 critically injured.

The blaze started near the stage of the bar in the popular Chatuchak district, then spread rapidly, cutting power and engulfing the room with smoke, eyewitnesses say.

Footage posted online show panicked customers screaming as they fled – some with their clothes on fire – through the flame-enveloped front door of Rong Beer Na Lat Phrao.

Firefighters, who arrived at the scene just after midnight, quickly extinguished the fire. They found the bodies of most of the victims in a bathroom, where they had apparently sought shelter.

Preliminary investigations by Bangkok's disaster mitigation department suggest the fire could have been caused by an electrical short circuit in an air conditioner, though no official cause has been given.

Despite official promises to improve fire and electrical safety standards following previous incidents, they are still often poorly enforced.

Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, who visited the scene early on Monday, said a musician who was performing when the fire broke out told him "there was blasting and everybody tried to flee from the smoke and flames".

Many people did not make it out of the bar because they "went to the back of the building and tried to hide themselves... in the toilet", the musician said, according to Anutin.

Firefighters, who were alerted to the blaze by a passing driver, were reportedly able to bring the flames under control in about half an hour.

However, despite their efforts, nine men and 18 women were killed. More than 60 are now being treated in hospital, including 22 who are in critical condition, authorities said.

Initial findings suggest the majority of the victims had died from smoke inhalation, said Suriyachai Raviwan, the director of Bangkok's disaster mitigation department.

Bangkok governor Chatchart Sittipunt say the flammable interior decorations on the bar's ceiling may have facilitated the blaze's rapid spread.

There are also reports of people found unconscious near the building's emergency exit, suggesting that there may have been some obstruction, the governor added.

Authorities say these suggestions can only be confirmed through further investigation by forensic officers.

One motorcyclist, Surin Jaiharn, told AFP that he helped about five people flee the burning bar using clothing to extinguish flames on their bodies.

"I feel depressed. I saw many deaths and I do not know the fate of the people I helped," he told AFP.

The driver who alerted the fire department told Thai news outlet the Daily News that he broke windows to help two people escape.

As of Monday morning, the bar has been cordoned off, with shattered windows and furniture piled up...
body.zh: 据泰国媒体报道，曼谷一家酒吧发生大火，造成至少 27 人死亡。 午夜刚过，消防队员就被叫到现场，发现顾客从被火焰包围的场地前门逃离。 未经证实的视频显示，酒吧里熊熊燃烧，一名女子倒在地上，然后站起来逃跑。 据当地媒体报道，泰国总理阿努廷·占维拉古 (Anutin Charnvirakul) 在现场告诉记者，已有 27 人死亡，多人被送往医院。他强调，起火原因仍在调查中。 据泰国媒体《每日新闻》外部报道，该酒吧位于乍都乍区，是该地区著名的娱乐场所和餐厅。 大火被扑灭后在酒吧内拍摄的照片显示，酒吧已完全烧焦并变黑，天花板剥落。 据泰国媒体Thairath对外报道，灾后仍有多人失踪。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of life in the Bangkok bar fire brings immense sorrow and reminds us of life's fragility. In moments of such profound grief, we remember that Yahweh himself, in Christ, wept at the death of a friend, showing deep compassion for human suffering. Our hearts go out to all affected by this sudden and devastating event.
reflection.zh: 曼谷酒吧火灾中生命的悲惨逝去带来了巨大的悲痛，提醒我们生命的脆弱。在如此深切的悲伤时刻，我们记得雅伟自己，在基督里，也曾为朋友的离世而哭泣，显明他对人类苦难的深切怜悯。我们为所有受此突发灾难影响的人们感到心痛。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: 'Immeasurable loss': Actor Sam Neill dies at 78
title.zh: “无法估量的损失”：演员山姆·尼尔去世，享年78岁

summary.en: New Zealand actor Sam Neill has passed away at the age of 78. His family announced that his death was "sudden and unexpected," describing the loss as "immeasurable."
summary.zh: 新西兰演员山姆·尼尔于78岁去世。他的家人宣布，他的去世是“突然且出乎意料的”，并形容这一损失“无法估量”。

body.en:
The Jurassic Park star's family announced the news on Instagram, saying he died on Monday in Sydney.

"Sam was surrounded by family and passed with the dignity that has characterised his whole life," the statement said.

"The loss was sudden and unexpected but blessed by the fact that Sam remained cancer free.

"They would like to express their deepest gratitude to the staff at St Vincent’s Private Hospital for their incredible care.

"More details will be shared later, but for now, on behalf of the family, we ask that you respect their privacy as they navigate this immeasurable loss."

Neill announced he was being treated for stage-three angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma in his 2023 memoir, Did I Ever Tell You This?

In late April this year, he announced he was cancer-free after undergoing trial treatment when chemotherapy stopped working on the stage-three blood cancer.

"I’ve been living with a particular type of lymphoma for about five years and I was on chemotherapy," he told 7News at the time. "Pretty miserable business but it was keeping me alive."

He said he was "very, very excited" to be cancer-free, adding, "it's time I did another movie".

Responding to the news of Neill's death , Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said Neill had starred in "so many beloved Australian stories and he earned a special place in Australian hearts".

"Wry and dry, thoughtful and laconic, Sam fought illness with the same dignity, humour and conviction that gave strength to his every performance," he said.

The actor's career spanned five decades, and included turns in The Piano, Thor: Love and Thunder, The Dish and Peter Rabbit. He also appeared in the popular British period drama series Peaky Blinders.

He was perhaps best known for his portrayal of Dr Alan Grant in the Jurassic Park movies.

Speaking to ABC's Australian Story about his cancer in 2023, Neill said he was "not remotely afraid" of death, but it would be "annoying" because he has more to do.

"It's out of my control. If you can't control it, don't get into it," he said of cancer.

body.zh: 这位侏罗纪公园明星的家人在 Instagram 上宣布了这一消息，称他周一在悉尼去世。 声明称：“萨姆在家人的陪伴下，带着他一生的尊严去世了。” “这次去世是突然而出乎意料的，但幸运的是，萨姆没有患癌症。 “他们要向圣文森特私立医院的工作人员表示最深切的感谢，感谢他们提供的令人难以置信的护理。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “更多细节将在稍后公布，但现在，我们代表家人请求您在他们度过这一不可估量的损失时尊重他们的隐私。” 尼尔在 2023 年的回忆录《我曾经告诉过你吗？》中宣布，他正在接受第三期血管免疫母细胞 T 细胞淋巴瘤的治疗。 今年四月下旬，当化疗对三期血癌不起作用时，他宣布在接受试验治疗后，他的癌症已经痊愈。 “我患有一种特殊类型的淋巴瘤大约五年了，并且一直在接受化疗，”他当时告诉七号新闻台。 “这是一件相当悲惨的事情，但它让我活了下来。” 他说他对摆脱癌症感到“非常非常兴奋”，并补充说，“是时候我再拍一部电影了”。 总理安东尼·艾博尼斯在回应尼尔去世的消息时表示，尼尔出演了“许多受人喜爱的澳大利亚故事，他在澳大利亚人心中赢得了特殊的地位”。 他说：“萨姆冷嘲热讽、深思熟虑、简洁明了，他以同样的尊严、幽默和信念与疾病作斗争，这给他的每一次表演都注入了力量。” 这位演员的职业生涯跨越了五十年，其中包括《钢琴》、《雷神：爱与雷霆》、《盘子》和《彼得兔》。他还出现在流行的英国历史剧《浴血黑帮》中。 他最著名的作品可能是在侏罗纪公园电影中扮演艾伦·格兰特博士。 尼尔在接受美国广播公司 (ABC) 的澳大利亚故事节目采访时谈到了 2023 年患癌症的情况，他说他“一点也不害怕”死亡，但这会“令人烦恼”，因为他还有更多事情要做。 “这超出了我的控制范围。如果你无法控制它，就不要陷入其中，”他谈到癌症时说道。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The news of Sam Neill's sudden passing reminds us of life's precious and often unpredictable nature. In moments of loss, we are called to reflect on the brevity of our own days and seek wisdom in how we live them. May we cherish each moment and live with purpose, knowing that Yahweh holds our times.
reflection.zh: 山姆·尼尔突然离世的消息提醒我们，生命是宝贵且常常出人意料的。在失去的时刻，我们被呼召反思自己日子的短暂，并寻求智慧来度过它们。愿我们珍惜每一个时刻，有目标地生活，深知雅伟掌管我们的时日。

verse.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verse.textZh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

title.en: Watch: At the scene where Bangkok's deadly bar fire unfolded
title.zh: 曼谷致命酒吧火灾现场：记者探访

summary.en: The BBC’s South East Asia correspondent visits the site where at least 27 people were killed during a bar fire in Thailand.
summary.zh: 英国广播公司东南亚记者探访了泰国一处酒吧火灾现场，该事故造成至少27人死亡。

body.en:
The BBC's South East Asia correspondent Jonathan Head has visited the site where at least 27 people were killed during a bar fire in Thailand.

The deadly blaze broke out at Rong Beer Na Lat Phrao – the local name of the bar – which is situated in the Chatuchak district of Bangkok.
body.zh: BBC 东南亚记者乔纳森·海德 (Jonathan Head) 访问了泰国酒吧火灾造成至少 27 人死亡的现场。 位于曼谷乍都乍区的 Rong Beer Na Lat Phrao 酒吧（该酒吧的当地名称）发生了致命火灾。

reflection.en: The news of lives lost in the Bangkok bar fire brings profound sorrow. In moments of such sudden tragedy, the shortest verse in the Bible reminds us that even Yahweh Himself wept at the death of a friend. Our tears are a natural and sacred response to the pain of loss, acknowledging the preciousness of each life.
reflection.zh: 曼谷酒吧火灾中生命逝去的消息令人深感悲痛。在如此突发的悲剧中，圣经中最短的经文提醒我们，即使是雅伟自己也曾为朋友的离世而哭泣。我们的眼泪是对失去的痛苦自然而神圣的回应，承认每个生命的宝贵。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Bombs, blood, ambushes - football coaching with the army
title.zh: 炸弹、鲜血、伏击——与军队一起的足球教练训练

summary.en: As part of the Football Association of Wales' Uefa pro licence course, football coaches are undergoing military training, including simulated experiences of bombs, blood, and ambushes, pushing them far beyond their usual comfort zones.
summary.zh: 作为威尔士足球协会欧足联职业教练执照课程的一部分，足球教练们正在接受军事训练，其中包括模拟炸弹、流血和伏击等体验，这让他们远远超出了自己的舒适区。

body.en:
The rising sun bathes the rolling Herefordshire hillsides in a warm glow as birds gently chirp and sheep graze in the fields.

But this rural idyll is shattered by the sound of explosions, followed by plumes of smoke and ear-splitting screams.

Six camouflaged men rush to the scene to find a soldier howling for help as he clutches his bloodied leg, half of which appears to have been blown off.

Thankfully, the blood is fake and this is an actor - albeit a former soldier and amputee - and the first responders are a group of football coaches studying for their Uefa Pro Licence, the sport's highest coaching qualification.

Former Arsenal midfielder and Wales captain Aaron Ramsey applies a tourniquet, while ex-Chelsea and Argentina goalkeeper Willy Caballero comforts the casualty.

Also part of the group are Peterborough United boss Luke Williams and Michael Wilde, who manages Colwyn Bay in the Cymru Premier, thrown together for this intensive, two-day exercise with military-trained personnel.

The Football Association of Wales' (FAW) pro licence course has been described as the "Harvard of football coaching", and counts Mikel Arteta, Arsenal's Premier League-winning manager, among its graduates.

By now, it is globally renowned, as illustrated by this latest batch of candidates.

"The FAW have earned themselves an incredible reputation in the world of coach education," says Michael Bradley, the former United States and Roma midfielder who is now coaching New York Red Bulls.

"I've had great experiences with the FAW. I did my B Licence, my A Licence here, and now to have the opportunity to complete my Pro Licence, it's a big honour."

Bradley has just been taking part in an ambush exercise, where he and his team are instructed to rescue a hostage in a forest and usher her to safety while fending off armed enemies.

Among the cohort of (paintball) gun-wielders in Bradley's team are Champions League-winning ex-Chelsea and France midfielder Florent Malouda and Wales international Will Vaulks.

These fledgling coaches come from all sorts of backgrounds. Perhaps most impressively, another former US international, Ella Masar, is doing this course while 36 weeks pregnant.

"I was giving the guys flak when they were carrying a 10-kilo bag on their backs. I'm like, 'Just switch it around to the front, and then you have a little bit of a day in the life'," she laughs.

"These guys have been so incredible, accepting and being so helpful. They all have wives and kids, and they've just really put a hand out.

"That respect, especially with the status of some of these, has been so rewarding for me. It's been incredible."

body.zh: 初升的太阳将赫里福德郡连绵起伏的山坡沐浴在温暖的光芒中，鸟儿轻轻地鸣叫，羊群在田野里吃草。 但爆炸声、滚滚浓烟和震耳欲聋的尖叫声打破了这片乡村田园风光。 六名身穿迷彩服的男子赶到现场，发现一名士兵抓着血迹斑斑的腿嚎叫着求救，半条腿似乎已被炸掉。 值得庆幸的是，血是假的，而且这是一名演员——尽管是一名前士兵和截肢者——而第一批响应者是一群正在学习欧足联职业执照的足球教练，这是这项运动的最高教练资格。 前阿森纳中场球员、威尔士队长亚伦·拉姆齐正在使用止血带，而前切尔西和阿根廷门将威利·卡瓦列罗正在安慰伤者。 该小组的成员还有彼得伯勒联队主教练卢克·威廉姆斯和管理塞浦路斯科尔文湾的迈克尔·王尔德，他们与受过军事训练的人员一起参加了这次为期两天的密集演习。 威尔士足球协会 (FAW) 的职业执照课程被誉为“足球教练界的哈佛”，阿森纳英超冠军主教练米克尔·阿尔特塔 (Mikel Arteta) 就是该课程的毕业生。 迄今为止，它已享誉全球，最新一批候选者就说明了这一点。 “一汽在教练教育领域赢得了令人难以置信的声誉，”前美国和罗马中场球员、现执教纽约红牛队的迈克尔·布拉德利 (Michael Bradley) 说道。 “我在一汽有过很棒的经历。我在这里取得了 B 驾照、A 驾照，现在有机会完成我的专业驾照，这是一种巨大的荣誉。” 布拉德利刚刚参加了一次伏击演习，他和他的团队奉命在森林中营救一名人质，并将她带到安全的地方，同时抵御武装敌人。 布拉德利队中的彩弹持枪者包括欧洲冠军联赛冠军、前切尔西和法国中场球员弗洛伦特·马卢达和威尔士国脚威尔·沃尔克斯。 这些初出茅庐的教练来自各种背景。也许最令人印象深刻的是，另一位前美国国脚埃拉·马萨尔 (Ella Masar) 在怀孕 36 周时正在学习这门课程。 “当他们背着一个 10 公斤重的包时，我对他们进行了严厉批评。我想，‘只要把它换到前面，然后你就可以过上美好的一天了’，”她笑着说。 “这些人真是太不可思议了，他们乐于接受，乐于助人。他们都有妻子和孩子，而且他们真的伸出了援助之手。 “这种尊重，尤其是其中一些人的地位，对我来说是非常有益的。这太不可思议了。” 由于明显的健康相关原因，玛莎无法完全参与这门课程的某些内容，但是，她可以做的任何事情，芝加哥红...

reflection.en: This intense military-style training for football coaches highlights the discipline and self-control required to excel in any demanding field. While the coaches pursue a professional license, Yahweh reminds us that true endurance and self-mastery lead to an imperishable reward. Such rigorous preparation, whether for sport or life, shapes character and...
reflection.zh: 足球教练们接受的这种军事化训练，突显了在任何要求严苛的领域中取得卓越成就所需的纪律和自制力。当教练们追求职业执照时，雅伟提醒我们，真正的忍耐和自我掌控会带来永不朽坏的奖赏。这种严谨的预备，无论是为了体育还是生活，都能塑造品格并显露内在的力量。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Bangkok pub fire kills at least 27 people
title.zh: 曼谷酒吧火灾致至少27人死亡

summary.en: At least 27 people have died in a pub fire in Bangkok. The cause of the blaze is currently unknown, though some speculate it may have been caused by indoor fireworks.
summary.zh: 曼谷一家酒吧发生火灾，造成至少27人死亡。起火原因尚不清楚，但有人猜测可能是室内烟花引发的。

body.en:
A huge fire has engulfed a pub in Bangkok, killing at least 27 people before firefighters brought the blaze under control, officials say.

Footage shared online by first responders shows a huge blaze raging, with plumes rising from the front door of the Na Ladprao pub in the northern part of the Thai capital early on Monday morning.

Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul told reporters at the scene that 27 people died and that several of the injured have been taken to the hospital.

Anutin said a musician who was performing at the pub told him that he saw smoke coming out of a circuit breaker near the stage before the power went out, then an explosion was heard and thick smoke quickly filled the place.

Many of victims were found at the restrooms, at the back of the pub, Anutin added.

Photos of the aftermath show charred tables and chairs, and the damaged interior of the pub.

Thai public broadcaster Thai PBS World reported that at least 30 people were killed in the fire at a packed beer house.

In 2022, 14 people were killed by a fire at a music pub in the eastern part of the country.

And more than a decade before that, 66 people were killed and more than 200 injured in a fire during a January 1, 2009 New Year's Eve celebration at the Santika nightclub in Thailand's capital.

reflection.en: The sudden loss of life in this tragic fire brings immense sorrow and reminds us of life's fragility. In such moments of profound darkness, we remember Yahweh's promise to be with us, even as we walk through the valley of the shadow of death, offering comfort and presence.
reflection.zh: 这场悲剧性火灾中生命的突然逝去带来了巨大的悲痛，也提醒我们生命的脆弱。在如此深沉的黑暗时刻，我们记念雅伟的应许，即使我们行过死荫的幽谷，他仍与我们同在，赐予我们安慰和同伴。

verse.textEn: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.

title.en: Sinner beats Zverev to retain Wimbledon title
title.zh: 辛纳击败兹维列夫，卫冕温网冠军

summary.en: Jannik Sinner successfully defended his Wimbledon title, defeating Alexander Zverev in the men's final. This victory marks his fifth Grand Slam crown and extends his winning streak against Zverev to ten consecutive matches.
summary.zh: 扬尼克·辛纳在周日的温网男单决赛中击败亚历山大·兹维列夫，成功卫冕温网冠军。这位意大利选手赢得了他的第五个大满贯头衔，并将其对阵兹维列夫的连胜纪录扩大到十场。

body.en:
Jannik Sinner retained his Wimbledon title by beating Alexander Zverev in Sunday's men's final. The Italian claims his fifth Grand Slam crown and extends his dominance over the German to 10 straight victories.

Italian top seed Jannik Sinner retained his Wimbledon men's singles title on Sunday, after rallying from a set down to beat Germany's second seed Alexander Zverev.

Zverev took the opening set in a tense tiebreak and pushed hard early, but Sinner responded with a dominant second-set tiebreak to level.

He then seized control in the third and fourth sets with superior baseline play and serving to close out the match in just under four hours.

"I'm very happy of course about the win, but I'm mostly very happy about the level we both played," Sinner said, continuing to praise Zverev.

"If you play like this I'm very, very sure you are going to have this one at home as well," he said, pointing at the trophy.

A dejected Zverev was left to ponder what could have been after a fourth ⁠Grand Slam final defeat.

"To be fair, I lost to you nine (sic) times in a row," he added, losing count of his run of defeats against Sinner.

"Congratulations to Jannik, he showed once again why he's the best player in the world. It was great to share Centre Court with you on the finals weekend. It's a great honour to be here. Unfortunately, it didn't go my way."

Zverev is the first German to contest the Wimbledon title match since Boris Becker in 1995.

body.zh: 扬尼克·辛纳 (Jannik Sinner) 在周日的男子决赛中击败亚历山大·兹维列夫 (Alexander Zverev)，卫冕温网冠军。意大利人第五次夺得大满贯冠军，并将对德国人的统治地位扩大到十连胜。 意大利头号种子詹尼克·辛纳周日在温布尔登网球公开赛上击败德国二号种子亚历山大·兹维列夫后，从一盘落后的情况下重整旗鼓，卫冕了温布尔登男单冠军。 兹维列夫在紧张的抢七中拿下首盘，并早早发力，但辛纳在第二盘抢七中占据统治地位，将比分追平。 随后，他在第三盘和第四盘中凭借出色的底线表现和发球控制了比赛，并在不到四个小时内结束了比赛。 “我当然对这场胜利感到非常高兴，但我主要对我们双方的表现感到非常高兴，”辛纳说道，并继续赞扬兹维列夫。 “如果你像这样打球，我非常非常肯定你也会在家里拥有这个，”他指着奖杯说道。 沮丧的兹维列夫开始思考第四次大满贯决赛失利后会发生什么。 “公平地说，我连续九次输给你（原文如此），”他补充道，忘记了自己连续输给辛纳的次数。 “恭喜詹尼克，他再次证明了为什么他是世界上最好的球员。很高兴能在决赛周末与大家共享中心球场。很荣幸来到这里。不幸的是，这并不符合我的意愿。” 兹维列夫是自 1995 年鲍里斯·贝克尔以来第一位参加温网冠军赛的德国人。

reflection.en: In competitive sports, athletes train with immense dedication, running their race to win the prize. Sinner's victory reminds us of the discipline and focus required to achieve excellence and secure a desired outcome.
reflection.zh: 在竞技体育中，运动员以极大的奉献精神训练，奔跑他们的赛程以赢得奖赏。辛纳的胜利提醒我们，要取得卓越成就并获得理想结果，需要何等的纪律和专注。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: France opens terror probe after gun found in Jewish suburb
title.zh: 法国在犹太郊区发现枪支后展开反恐调查

summary.en: French police have initiated a terror investigation after discovering a military-grade weapon in a suspicious car. The vehicle was found parked in a Paris neighborhood known for its significant Jewish population.
summary.zh: 法国警方在巴黎一个犹太人口众多的社区，于一辆可疑汽车中发现一件“军用级武器”后，已展开反恐调查。

body.en:
Police said they found a "military-grade weapon" during the search of a suspicious car parked in a Paris neighborhood with a large Jewish population.

Anti-terror prosecutors in France opened a probe on Sunday after at least one gun was found in a car parked near a synagogue in a Paris suburb.

France, home to Europe's largest Jewish population, has seen a surge of antisemitic crimes since the beginning Israel's war against the Palestinian military group, Hamas in Gaza .

The discovery was made on Saturday in the northern Paris neighborhood of Sarcelles, which has a large Jewish population.

According to Interior Minister Laurent Nunez, the gun found was a "military-grade weapon" and was found near one of the town's synagogues.

Nunez said a motive had not been established and no arrests had been made so far.

Prosecutors said they had opened an investigation "on charges of forming a terrorist criminal organisation with a view to preparing crimes involving attacks on persons and the transport, possession and acquisition of weapons in connection with a terrorist enterprise."

The suspect car was parked close to a cinema and restaurants in a busy neighborhood, AFP news agency reported.

AFP cited a police source as saying that no explosives were found, but an assault-style rifle and a handgun were retrieved.

France has seen a sharp rise in antisemitism since the October 7, 2023 Hamas attacks on Israel.

French police have so far this year foiled three planned attacks on the Jewish community, Nunez said, including a knife attack on a gendarme beneath the Arc de Triomphe in February.

Last year, the country recorded 1,320 antisemitic acts , a tripling in three years.

The acts made up over half of all anti-religious incidents, even though Jews make up less than 1% of the French population.

French President Emmanuel Macron criticized the rising "old demons" of antisemitism during a speech Sunday, which he said had darkened France's past and present.

Macron was at the launch of a statue honoring Capt. Alfred Dreyfus, whose wrongful 19th-century treason conviction exposed deeply rooted anti-Jewish bias in France.

Sunday marked 120 years since Dreyfus' exoneration by France's highest court. His statue now stands outside the court, the Palace of Justice, in Paris.

Dreyfus, who was Jewish, received a life sentence after being falsely accused of passing military secrets to Germany.

Critics said the French military had made Dreyfus a scapegoat and he was later cleared of all charges.
body.zh: 警方表示，他们在搜查一辆停在巴黎犹太人聚居区的可疑汽车时发现了“军用级武器”。 法国反恐检察官周日在巴黎郊区犹太教堂附近停放的一辆汽车中发现至少一把枪后展开调查。 法国是欧洲犹太人口最多的国家，自从以色列在加沙对巴勒斯坦军事组织哈马斯发动战争以来，法国反犹太主义犯罪激增。 这一发现是周六在巴黎北部的萨塞勒附近发现的，那里有大量犹太人口。 据内政部长洛朗·努涅斯称，发现的枪是“军用级武器”，是在该镇的一个犹太教堂附近发现的。 努涅斯说，动机尚未确定，到目前为止尚未逮捕任何人。 检察官表示，他们已“以组建恐怖主义犯罪组织的罪名展开调查，其目的是准备涉及袭击人员以及与恐怖主义企业有关的运输、拥有和获取武器的犯罪活动。” 据法新社报道，这辆嫌疑汽车停在繁忙街区的一家电影院和餐馆附近。 法新社援引警方消息人士的话称，没有发现爆炸物，但找到了一支突击步枪和一把手枪。 自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击以色列以来，法国反犹太主义急剧上升。 努涅斯说，法国警方今年迄今已挫败了三起针对犹太社区的袭击计划，其中包括二月份在凯旋门下对一名宪兵的持刀袭击。 去年，该国记录了 1,320 起反犹太主义行为，三年内增加了两倍。 尽管犹太人只占法国人口的不到 1%，但这些行为占所有反宗教事件的一半以上。 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在周日的一次演讲中批评了反犹太主义“老恶魔”的崛起，他说这让法国的过去和现在变得更加黑暗。 马克龙出席了纪念阿尔弗雷德·德雷福斯上尉雕像的落成典礼，他在 19 世纪被错误地定罪为叛国罪，暴露了法国根深蒂固的反犹太偏见。 周日是法国最高法院宣布德雷福斯无罪 120 周年纪念日。他的雕像现在矗立在巴黎司法宫外。 德雷福斯是犹太人，因被错误指控向德国传递军事机密而被判处无期徒刑。 批评者称，法国军方让德雷福斯成为替罪羊，后来他被洗清了所有罪名。

reflection.en: The discovery of a military-grade weapon in a residential area naturally causes alarm and insecurity. In such moments of potential trouble, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help. This truth offers a steady anchor for communities facing threats, encouraging reliance on divine protection and peace.
reflection.zh: 在居民区发现军用武器自然会引起警报和不安。在这样潜在的困境中，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。这一真理为面临威胁的社区提供了一个稳固的锚，鼓励他们依靠神的保护和赐予的平安。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Iran strikes Gulf neighbours in retaliation for US attacks, says it's hit two ships in Hormuz
title.zh: 伊朗报复美国袭击，打击海湾邻国，称已击中霍尔木兹海峡两艘船只

summary.en: Officials report that Iran has launched strikes against Gulf neighbors, claiming to have targeted two ships in the Strait of Hormuz. This action follows a declaration by Donald Trump ending a ceasefire that began on February 28, which was intended to halt a war initiated by the US and Israel.
summary.zh: 官员报告称，伊朗已对海湾邻国发动袭击，并声称在霍尔木兹海峡袭击了两艘船只。此前，唐纳德·特朗普宣布结束了2月28日开始的停火，该停火旨在停止由美国和以色列发动的战争。

body.en:
Iran announced it was closing the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday and launched missiles and drones at its Gulf neighbours. The moves came in retaliation for new US strikes following an attack by Iranian forces on a merchant vessel.

Sirens and explosions were heard in Qatar, the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain, AFP journalists and local authorities reported, the latest escalation to undermine an interim agreement between Washington and Tehran aimed at ending the war.

The Pentagon said it had struck Iran early Sunday after Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) fired on a Cyprus-registered container ship they said was sailing an "unauthorised route" through the Strait of Hormuz.

Iranian media reported explosions in Bandar Abbas, Sirik, Jask and on Qeshm Island, as well as in Khuzestan province that borders Iraq, with no immediate reports of casualties.

Hours later, air raid sirens sounded over Bahrain, while the United Arab Emirates and Qatar said they intercepted missile attacks.

The IRGC said they struck and stopped a vessel ignoring repeated instructions to use an approved shipping corridor, according to a statement carried by Iranian news agency IRNA.

"Following this incident... the Strait of Hormuz will be closed until further notice and until the end of American interventions in this region," the IRGC said.

The closure of the strategic waterway marks the latest escalation in a dispute that has become one of the main roadblocks to a final US-Iran agreement.

Tehran insists it will regulate shipping through Hormuz, while Washington demands unrestricted navigation through a route that carries roughly a fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas trade.

Although Iran called the strike on the ship "warning shots", the US military said Tehran "blatantly attacked" a Cyprus-flagged container ship transiting the Strait of Hormuz.

A crew member was missing and the vessel had been disabled by fire and damage to its engine room, US Central Command (CENTCOM) said.

The crew abandoned the vessel and were on a lifeboat, British maritime agency UKMTO reported, adding the incident occurred around 17km east of Oman.

The IRGC also announced it had hit a second vessel in the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, state media reported.

"A second vessel accused of violating regulations in the Strait of Hormuz has been struck," the IRGC said in a statement carried by state television IRIB, adding they had also attacked a US base in Qatar.

The US strikes, which began at 9.15am AEST, were the third round carried out this week and were taking place at the direction of US President Donald Trump, CENTCOM said.

title.en: China’s massive AI rollout - podcast
title.zh: 中国大规模人工智能推广——播客

summary.en: Senior China correspondent Amy Hawkins reports on China's extensive adoption of AI technology, which is being integrated into various sectors from medical avatars and food delivery drones to state surveillance.
summary.zh: 资深中国记者艾米·霍金斯报道了中国大规模采用人工智能技术的情况，该技术正被广泛应用于医疗虚拟形象、食品配送无人机以及国家监控等各个领域。

body.en: Senior China correspondent Amy Hawkins on China’s embrace of AI, from medical avatars to food delivery drones and state surveillance While the spread of AI has been met perhaps with a lot of scepticism in the west, China has fully embraced the technology, explains Amy Hawkins , from millions of users talking to AI doctors, to the use of intelligent robots in factories, and drones delivering food on the Great Wall of China. AI has also been eagerly taken up by the state, not least in the opportunities it provides for further surveillance, the Guardian’s senior China correspondent says. Continue reading...
body.zh: 资深驻华记者艾米·霍金斯 (Amy Hawkins) 谈论中国对人工智能的接受，从医疗化身到食品配送无人机和国家监控。艾米·霍金斯解释说，尽管人工智能的传播在西方可能遭到了很多怀疑，但中国已经完全接受了这项技术，从数百万用户与人工智能医生交谈，到在工厂中使用智能机器人，再到在中国长城上使用无人机运送食物。英国《卫报》驻华高级记者表示，国家也热切地采用人工智能，尤其是它为进一步监控提供了机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As China rapidly deploys AI across many aspects of life, including surveillance and medical avatars, it prompts us to consider the profound implications for human dignity. Yahweh created humanity in His own image, bestowing inherent worth that technology must always respect and serve, not diminish.
reflection.zh: 随着中国在生活各个领域迅速部署人工智能，包括监控和医疗虚拟形象，这促使我们思考其对人类尊严的深远影响。雅伟照着自己的形象创造了人类，赋予了我们固有的价值，科技必须始终尊重并服务于这一价值，而非削弱它。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: The kindness of strangers: I was hopelessly ill in China – then hotel staff offered to take my elderly father sightseeing
title.zh: 陌生人的善意：我在中国病得绝望，然后酒店员工主动提出带我年迈的父亲去观光

summary.en: An individual recounts falling severely ill in China while traveling with their elderly father. Hotel staff went above and beyond, not only assisting the sick traveler but also offering to take the father sightseeing, demonstrating remarkable compassion.
summary.zh: 一位旅客讲述了在中国旅行期间与年迈的父亲同行时，自己突发重病。酒店员工不仅悉心照料生病的旅客，还主动提出带其父亲去观光，展现了非凡的同情心。

body.en: Before they left, the receptionist delicately straightened my father’s collar. I knew then they would be just fine Read more in the kindness of strangers series The food poisoning hit like a tsunami. I remember being out at a dumpling restaurant, grabbing a heap of napkins and just vomiting directly into them. I’ve never been sick like that in my life. I was travelling in Xi’an, China, with my father, who was then aged 88 or 89. I really should have been in hospital but I didn’t feel I could leave my dear dad on his own. Instead I retreated to my hotel room, where I spent the night projectile vomiting. A horrible, embarrassing experience. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在他们离开之前，接待员小心翼翼地帮我父亲拉直了衣领。我知道他们会没事的。阅读更多《陌生人的善意》系列文章食物中毒像海啸一样袭来。我记得当时在一家饺子馆，抓起一堆餐巾纸，直接吐在上面。我一生中从未生过这样的病。我当时和父亲一起在中国西安旅行，他当时已经 88 或 89 岁了。我真的应该住院，但我觉得我不能独自离开我亲爱的父亲。相反，我回到了酒店房间，在那里度过了一夜的喷射性呕吐。一次可怕、尴尬的经历。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This heartwarming story reminds us that acts of kindness towards those in vulnerable situations—the sick and the stranger—are deeply meaningful. Yahweh teaches that when we care for "the least of these," we are, in essence, caring for Him. The hotel staff's compassion for both the ill traveler and their elderly father beautifully illustrates this principle.
reflection.zh: 这个暖心的故事提醒我们，对那些身处困境的人——生病者和陌生人——施以善意，是意义深远的。雅伟教导我们，当我们照顾“这些最小的弟兄”时，我们实际上就是在照顾他。酒店员工对生病旅客及其年迈父亲的关怀，完美地诠释了这一原则。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: China evacuates nearly two million people as powerful typhoon makes landfall
title.zh: 中国严阵以待，一周内第二场台风“巴威”逼近登陆

summary.en: Hundreds of thousands of people are being evacuated from eastern Zhejiang province as Typhoon Bavi approaches landfall, with the city of Wenzhou directly in its projected path.
summary.zh: 随着台风“巴威”逼近登陆，中国东部浙江省数十万人被疏散，温州市位于风暴的预计路径上。

body.en:
A powerful typhoon has made landfall in China, the second to hit the country in a week, with nearly two million people evacuated from areas in the path of the storm.

Typhoon Bavi, which spans 1,000km (620 miles) at its widest point - roughly the width of France - first came ashore in the coastal city of Taizhou on Saturday , external evening before making a second landfall in Wenzhou around midnight (17:00 GMT).

After pummelling a chain of remote Japanese islands, it brought heavy rainfall to Taiwan as it brushed past its northern tip.

Earlier landslides triggered by the storm killed at least 17 people in the Philippines.

Though it has weakened to a severe tropical storm, it still presents a risk because of the huge volume of moisture within its rain bands.

The storm is expected to gradually diminish in its intensity as it moves north-west.

On Sunday morning, the centre of the typhoon reached Hangzhou City in Zhejiang province, Chinese state media reported.

Forecasters said the typhoon would move to eastern Anhui on Monday, and to the northern Yellow Sea from the Shandong Peninsula on Tuesday.

More than 1.7 million people were evacuated in Zhejiang and thousands more in neighbouring provinces, state media said. Schools, work and outdoor activities have been suspended in Zhejiang, while 400 flights and dozens of train services have been cancelled.

The city of Wenzhou, home to around 10 million people, is close to the path of the storm, with authorities evacuating hundreds of thousands of residents.

"We could hear roof tiles and tree branches falling," Li Liangxing, a resident of the city told Reuters, adding "of course we were scared."

Beijing had ordered the evacuation of 100,000 people to "avoid risk", officials said.

Bavi began as a super typhoon, battering Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands last Monday with wind speeds of 290km/h (180mph).

As it made its way through the Pacific, weakening to 144 km/h winds, it struck the Sakishima islands, part of Japan's Ryukyu island chain between the country's main islands and Taiwan. At least five people were injured and thousands were without power.

Taiwan itself did not receive a direct hit but thousands of people were forced to leave their homes and there was a danger of landslides after heavy rain. Neither country has reported any deaths.

Taiwanese authorities had warned that Bavi could bring up to 1m (39 inches) of rainfall.

Dozens of flights have been cancelled while schools have suspended classes across the region. Supermarket shelves have been wiped clean as residents stock up on supplies.

Parts of southern China are still reeling from the devastation brought by Typhoon Maysak earlier this week.

reflection.en: As communities face the imminent threat of a typhoon, the need for safety and refuge becomes paramount. Psalm 46:1 reminds us that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble, offering a source of peace amidst the storm.

title.en: Typhoon Bavi hits China after battering Taiwan, Japan
title.zh: 台风“巴威”袭击中国，此前已重创台湾、日本

summary.en: Typhoon Bavi caused widespread disruption across Asia, forcing hundreds of thousands to evacuate in China, leading to power outages in Japan and Taiwan, and triggering deadly landslides in the Philippines.
summary.zh: 台风“巴威”在亚洲造成广泛破坏，导致中国数十万人撤离，日本和台湾停电，并在菲律宾引发致命山体滑坡。

body.en:
Bavi has forced hundreds of thousands to evacuate in China, knocked out power in Japan and Taiwan, and triggered deadly landslides in the Philippines.

Typhoon Bavi made landfall in China 's eastern province of Zhejiang late Saturday, state media reported.

More than 1.7 million people were evacuated as China braced for Bavi, which is expected to move northwestward inland after the landfall, with its intensity gradually weakening.

Bavi previously battered Japan's southern islands with heavy rain and strong winds, and brought life in Taiwan to a near standstill.

In Taiwan , the typhoon has prompted the "evacuation of more than 10,000 people at risk from landslides and left over 150,000 households without power," DW's Taiwan correspondent Rik Glauert said.

Authorities cancelled more than 1,100 domestic and international flights, while schools and offices were closed for two days.

Although the storm has been downgraded from a super typhoon as it has moved westwards, "winds exceeding 100 kph and more than a meter of rainfall are battering the capital Taipei, toppling trees and power lines, swelling rivers and causing localized flooding," Glauert reported.

In Japan's Okinawa prefecture, the storm lashed the Sakishima island chain with sustained winds of 144 kilometers (90 miles) per hour.

More than 24,000 households have lost power, while 345 flights have been canceled and ferry services have been suspended.

The storm, which began as a "super typhoon" over the US Pacific territories of Guam and the Northern Marianas last week, also triggered floods and landslides in the Philippines, killing at least 17 people, while nine were missing in the southern island of Mindanao.

Ten people died in a landslide in the town of Malapatan in the province of Sarangani, while two drowned in Bukidnon province. Five others died in a landslide in Lanao del Sur, the Philippines' meteorological agency said, adding that at least four people were injured in landslides.

Over 500,000 have been affected by the storm, with more than 11,000 forced from their homes.

title.en: Nearly two million evacuated as Typhoon Bavi barrels towards China
title.zh: 强台风巴威逼近中国，近两百万人被疏散

summary.en: A powerful typhoon, Bavi, is approaching China, prompting the evacuation of nearly two million people. In the Philippines, heavy rains associated with the storm have already caused two landslides, resulting in 17 fatalities.

body.en:
China evacuated more than 1.8 million people on Saturday as Typhoon Bavi churned toward the major eastern city of Wenzhou after pummelling Japan's southern Sakishima island chain with heavy rain and violent winds and brushing past northern Taiwan.

Even as Bavi continues to slow and weaken on its northwesterly path over cooler seas, the typhoon is still a potent risk due to the sheer volume of moisture it holds within its rain bands, about the size of France from end to end.

Bavi had maximum sustained winds of 144 km/h, equivalent to Category 1 on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale, and was about 200km southeast of Wenling in the eastern province of Zhejiang as of Saturday night (AEST), according to the National Meteorological Center.

Bavi is forecast to make landfall around Wenzhou, home to some 10 million people, early on Sunday.

State media said more than 1.7 million people had been evacuated across Zhejiang province, where Wenzhou is located, and more than 100,000 in neighbouring Fujian province.

"I'm a little worried, but I think it'll be OK. We've been through typhoons before. We'll get through it," said Wenzhou resident Huang Xinghuan, 50, who was out buying groceries at a traditional wet market before it closed ahead of the typhoon.

Huang said his family had stocked about two to three days' worth of water. "I think supplies are well guaranteed now. There's no need to panic or stockpile a lot of food or other supplies," he added.

While Japan and Taiwan have not so far reported any deaths from the typhoon, 17 people died in the Philippines due to heavy rains brought by an enhanced southwest monsoon, worsened by Bavi's impact.

Taiwan's fire department said 87 people had been injured, mostly falls from motorcycles or bicycles, as well as people falling over or being struck by objects.

More than 18,000 households and facilities across Okinawa, Japan lost power as the typhoon pounded Japan's remote southwestern islands, with the Miyako region hardest hit.

Japanese airlines cancelled dozens of flights, affecting more than 26,000 passengers.

"Miyako is taking worst of typhoon Bavi," professional storm-chaser James Reynolds posted on X from Ishigaki on Saturday.

"Conditions on Ishigaki gale force with some overnight gusts to typhoon strength."

In Taiwan, the government evacuated more than 14,000 people from mainly mountainous areas as the island shut down for the approach of Bavi to the north.

While Bavi did not make landfall on Taiwan, the government took precautions to prevent loss of life, given forecasts for almost 1 metre (3 feet) of rain in some areas.

summary.en: Hundreds of snakes, including king ratsnakes and cobras, have escaped from flooded breeding farms in southern China. This incident occurred as severe storms, including typhoon Maysak, caused widespread flooding in the region.
summary.zh: 中国南方多地遭受严重风暴袭击，台风“美莎克”引发洪水，导致数百条蛇，包括王锦蛇和眼镜蛇，从被淹的养殖场逃逸。

body.en: Local media in Hengzhou report king ratsnakes and cobras among hundreds in flood waters caused by typhoon Maysak Hundreds of snakes, including cobras, have escaped from flooded breeding farms in southern China as severe storms continue to batter parts of the country. State media reported that a snake farm in Hengzhou, in Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region, was hit by flood waters after days of heavy rainfall caused by typhoon Maysak , prompting warnings for nearby residents. Continue reading...
body.zh: 衡州当地媒体报道称，台风“美莎克”引发的洪水中，有数百条蛇王和眼镜蛇。随着严重风暴继续袭击中国部分地区，包括眼镜蛇在内的数百条蛇从中国南部被洪水淹没的养殖场中逃出。官方媒体报道称，台风“美莎”连日来带来强降雨，广西壮族自治区横州的一个养蛇场遭到洪水袭击，附近居民收到警告。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The escape of venomous snakes during severe flooding reminds us of creation's vulnerability when faced with powerful natural forces. Romans 8:22 speaks to how the whole creation groans under the weight of disruption, a reality keenly felt when disasters lead to unexpected dangers. In such times, we are called to care for both human safety and the wider...
reflection.zh: 毒蛇在严重洪水中逃逸，提醒我们面对强大自然力量时，受造界的脆弱性。罗马书8:22提到整个受造界都在劳苦叹息，当灾难带来意想不到的危险时，这种感受尤为强烈。在这样的时刻，我们蒙召要关顾人类安全和更广阔的自然界，信靠雅伟最终的掌权。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Typhoon, tornadoes, landslides: deadly weather ravages China – in pictures
title.zh: 台风、龙卷风、山体滑坡：致命天气肆虐中国（图）

summary.en: Typhoon Maysak and severe storms, including tornadoes and landslides, have caused widespread devastation across China, resulting in at least 15 fatalities in Guangxi and Hubei provinces.
summary.zh: 台风“美莎克”和包括龙卷风、山体滑坡在内的严重风暴在中国各地造成了广泛破坏，导致广西和湖北省至少15人死亡。

reflection.en: In the face of devastating natural disasters like typhoons and tornadoes, human vulnerability is starkly revealed. Psalm 46:1 reminds us that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Even amidst the chaos and loss, we can find solace in the enduring presence of the Divine.
reflection.zh: 面对台风和龙卷风等毁灭性的自然灾害，人类的脆弱性显露无遗。诗篇46:1提醒我们，雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。即使在混乱和损失之中，我们也能在神永恒的同在中找到慰藉。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: German car industry warns of job collapse unless ‘bold decisions’ made to address Chinese threat
title.zh: 德国汽车工业警告：若不“大胆决策”应对中国威胁，就业将崩溃

summary.en: The German automotive industry has issued a stark warning about potential widespread job losses, with Volkswagen reportedly considering cutting 100,000 positions. The industry indicates that significant changes, including possible foreign ownership of plants, are necessary to address competitive pressures,...
summary.zh: 德国汽车工业发出严峻警告，称除非采取“大胆决策”应对来自中国的威胁，否则该行业将面临大规模失业。大众汽车据报正考虑裁员10万人，并表示为保住就业，汽车工厂可能需要接受外国所有权。

body.en: VW to propose 100,000 job losses to board and says car plants could be put under foreign ownership to save jobs Europe live – latest updates The German car industry has warned of a potential collapse of employment in the sector in Europe unless society and workers accept that “bold decisions” are needed to address competition from the Chinese and other rivals. Volkswagen is preparing to formally propose up to 100,000 job losses , a move that has triggered a wave of protests. Continue reading...
body.zh: 大众汽车提议裁员10万人，并表示汽车工厂可能会被外资所有，以挽救欧洲的就业机会——最新动态 德国汽车行业警告称，除非社会和工人接受需要“大胆决定”来应对来自中国和其他竞争对手的竞争，否则欧洲该行业的就业可能会崩溃。大众汽车准备正式提出最多裁员10万人，此举引发了一波抗议浪潮。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The German car industry's warning of job collapse highlights the critical need for wise leadership and strategic direction in times of economic upheaval. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that without guidance, a people may fall, but safety is found in an abundance of counselors. As leaders face difficult choices to protect livelihoods, seeking diverse and sound...
reflection.zh: 德国汽车业关于就业崩溃的警告，凸显了在经济动荡时期，明智的领导和战略方向至关重要。箴言11:14提醒我们，没有引导，民就衰败，谋士众多，人便安居。当领导者面临保护生计的艰难抉择时，寻求多元而健全的建议对于应对复杂的全球挑战至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Plenty of players but no grassroots: can China ever grow into a footballing giant?
title.zh: 球员众多但缺乏基层：中国能否成长为足球强国？

summary.en: Officials note that while China boasts large amateur football crowds, these events often serve as spectacles rather than structured pathways for players to advance to professional levels, indicating a gap in grassroots development.
summary.zh: 专家指出，尽管中国的业余足球比赛吸引了大量观众，但这些比赛更多是表演而非球员通往职业赛场的途径，这表明基层发展存在不足。

body.en: Some of its amateur matches pull in bigger crowds than European leagues but are more of a spectacle than a pathway to the professional game, say experts Michael Owen, a man who once quipped he had never drunk tea or coffee, isn’t known for his adventurous palate. Safe to assume, then, that the former England striker was out of his comfort zone sipping Roxburgh rose juice and eating chilli-wrapped rice noodle rolls during his recent visit to south-west China’s Guizhou province. The 2001 Ballon d’Or winner dusted off his boots for a match in Rongjiang county, the birthplace of viral amateur football league Cun Chao, also known as the Village Super League. Scoring twice in a 4-3 loss for local side Rongjiang Niubi, Owen endeared himself to the thousands in attendance, even if some weren’t familiar with the former Liverpool and Real Madrid player. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家迈克尔·欧文(Michael Owen)表示，它的一些业余比赛比欧洲联赛吸引了更多的观众，但更多的是一场奇观，而不是进入职业比赛的途径。迈克尔·欧文曾打趣说，他从未喝过茶或咖啡，但他并不以冒险的味觉而闻名。那么，可以肯定的是，这位前英格兰前锋在最近访问中国西南部的贵州省期间，已经走出了自己的舒适区，喝着罗克斯堡玫瑰汁，吃着辣椒卷。这位2001年金球奖得主在榕江县的一场比赛中掸掉了靴子上的灰尘，那里是风靡一时的业余足球联赛存超（也称为乡村超级联赛）的发源地。在当地球队榕江牛鼻子队以4-3输球的比赛中，欧文梅开二度，赢得了数千名现场观众的喜爱，尽管有些人对这位前利物浦和皇家马德里球员并不熟悉。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The challenge of building a robust football culture in China, despite widespread enthusiasm, highlights the importance of foundational development. Just as Proverbs reminds us to train the young, true excellence in any field often stems from consistent, early nurturing and clear pathways for growth. This story invites us to consider where we might invest in...
reflection.zh: 中国足球文化建设面临的挑战，尽管有广泛的热情，却凸显了基础发展的重要性。正如箴言提醒我们要训练年轻人，任何领域的真正卓越往往源于持续、早期的培养和清晰的成长路径。这个故事邀请我们思考，我们可以在哪些方面投入基础性努力，以培养持久的成功。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: Australia Desk
title.zh: 澳洲栏目

strap.en: Public life, policy, and community stories shaping Australia now.
strap.zh: 关注正在影响澳洲公共生活、政策与社区的新闻。

title.en: More than 120 families contacted in AFP investigation – as it happened
title.zh: 澳大利亚新闻直播：弗吉尼亚·贝尔称，皇家委员会证人在作证后遭受“丑陋的反犹太袭击”

summary.en: Virginia Bell, who leads a royal commission, stated that witnesses giving evidence have faced “ugly antisemitic attacks” after their appearances. Higher education chiefs, academics, and students are scheduled to testify at the latest hearings.
summary.zh: 皇家委员会主席弗吉尼亚·贝尔表示，在委员会作证的证人受到了“丑陋的反犹太袭击”。高等教育界负责人、学者和学生将在最新一轮听证会上作证。

body.en:
The Australian federal police has contacted more than 120 families as it investigates alleged offending by a former Sydney childcare worker.

The former partner of a woman whose body was found near Toowoomba at the weekend has appeared in court for the first time after being charged with her murder .

Sam Neill , the versatile New Zealand actor whose career spanned Oscar winners and blockbusters such as The Piano and Jurassic Park, has died aged 78 .

An academic at UNSW was subjected to Nazi salutes by students in his business class , the royal commission into antisemitism and social cohesion has heard.

The Albanese government has announced it will roll out digital passenger cards to all Australian international airports and seaports after a “successful” trial on Qantas flights into Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne.

The federal government has been accused of exploiting international students and permanent residents after non-refundable visa fees were quietly hiked by up to 200% , placing Australia well in excess of other western countries.
body.zh: 皇家专员维吉尼亚·贝尔 AC SC 表示，犹太证人在提供自己的反犹太主义经历的证据后，遭到了“丑陋的反犹太主义攻击”。 本周在墨尔本举行的第四场听证会正在审查犹太学生和学者的反犹太主义生活经历，包括大学对此的反应。 贝尔在周一的听证会开幕式上提请大家注意《皇家委员会法》的规定，该法规定，因证据而对他人造成任何损害或不利的行为属于可起诉犯罪行为。 周一，四名学者和学生以化名提供证据。出席的还有巴勒斯坦学生组织联合召集人兼全国学生联合会教育官员亚斯明·约翰逊 (Yasmine Johnson)、澳大利亚人权委员会主席休·德·克雷斯特 (Hugh de Krester) 和澳大利亚反对反犹太主义学术联盟的乔什·凯勒 (Josh Keller)。

reflection.en: The report of witnesses enduring “ugly antisemitic attacks” highlights the painful reality that words can be wielded like weapons, causing deep wounds. Proverbs 12:18 reminds us that while rash words can pierce like swords, the tongue of the wise offers healing. In a world where public discourse often turns hostile, we are called to speak with wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 证人遭受“丑陋的反犹太袭击”的报道，凸显了言语能像武器一样伤人的痛苦现实。箴言12:18提醒我们，虽然鲁莽的言语如刀剑刺人，但智慧人的舌头却能带来医治。在一个公共言论常变得充满敌意的世界里，我们蒙召要以智慧和怜悯说话，特别是对那些勇敢说出真相的人。

verse.textEn: The words of the reckless pierce like swords, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
verse.textZh: 说话浮躁的，如刀刺人；智慧人的舌头却为医人的良药。

title.en: ‘We should be dead’: Perth’s Indigenous community felt ignored after alleged Invasion Day bombing attempt, inquiry told
title.zh: 珀斯原住民社区称“我们本该死去”，指控“入侵日”炸弹袭击未遂后被忽视

summary.en: A parliamentary inquiry in Australia was told that Perth's Indigenous community felt ignored by police after an alleged bombing attempt at an Invasion Day rally. Police reportedly knew of unspecified threats before the January 26 event but did not meet with rally organizers until afterward.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚议会调查获悉，珀斯原住民社区在一次“入侵日”集会中遭遇炸弹袭击未遂后，感到警方忽视了他们。据称，警方在1月26日活动前已知悉未具体说明的威胁，但直到事后才与集会组织者会面。

body.en: Police were told of unspecified threats before the 26 January rally but did not meet with organisers until after, parliamentary inquiry into racism told Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Indigenous community members who witnessed the alleged attempted terror attack at the Invasion Day rally in Perth have told a federal inquiry into racism and hate directed at First Nations people that they felt dismissed and ignored by authorities. Western Australia police declared the incident was being investigated as a terror attack nine days after an alleged homemade bomb, filled with ball bearings, screws and other projectiles, was thrown into the crowd of 2,000 people at Forrest Place on 26 January. Perth man Liam Alexander Hall has been charged with terrorism offences and is in custody, and his lawyers have indicated he intends to plead not guilty by way of insanity . Continue reading...
body.zh: 议会对种族主义的调查告诉警方，在 1 月 26 日集会之前，警方接到了未具体说明的威胁，但直到之后才与组织者会面。 议会对种族主义的调查告诉关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客，了解最新动态 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 目击了珀斯入侵日集会中所谓的恐怖袭击未遂事件的原住民社区成员告诉一项针对原住民的种族主义和仇恨的联邦调查，他们感到被当局忽视和忽视。 1 月 26 日，一枚装有滚珠轴承、螺丝和其他射弹的自制炸弹被扔向福雷斯特广场 (Forrest Place) 的 2000 人人群，九天后，西澳大利亚警方宣布将此事件作为恐怖袭击进行调查。珀斯男子利亚姆·亚历山大·霍尔被指控犯有恐怖主义罪并被拘留，他的律师表示他打算以精神错乱为由表示不认罪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The distress of Perth's Indigenous community, feeling unheard by authorities despite known threats, highlights the profound need for those in power to listen to and protect the vulnerable. Proverbs 31:8 reminds us to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, advocating for the rights of all who are destitute. This incident underscores the ongoing...
reflection.zh: 珀斯原住民社区在已知威胁面前感到被当局忽视的痛苦，凸显了当权者倾听和保护弱势群体的深切需要。箴言31:8提醒我们，要为不能为自己说话的人开口，为所有贫困者的权利辩护。这一事件强调了为社会每个成员争取正义和同等保护的持续呼吁，反映了雅伟对边缘群体的关怀。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Sam Neill tributes: actors, directors and leaders remember ‘a true gentleman’
title.zh: 萨姆·尼尔悼词：演员、导演和领袖们缅怀这位“真正的绅士”

summary.en: The acclaimed actor Sam Neill, known for over 100 films including 'Jurassic Park' and 'The Piano,' has died at 78. Tributes from actors, directors, and leaders remember him as a true gentleman, a champion of New Zealand's arts, culture, and environment, and a generous collaborator and friend.
summary.zh: 著名演员萨姆·尼尔，因出演《侏罗纪公园》和《钢琴课》等百余部电影而闻名，享年78岁。演员、导演和领袖们纷纷发表悼词，缅怀他是一位真正的绅士，新西兰艺术、文化和环境的倡导者，以及一位慷慨的合作者和朋友。

body.en: The star of more than 100 films is remembered as a champion of New Zealand’s arts, culture and environment, and a generous collaborator and friend Sam Neill, star of Jurassic Park films and The Piano, dies aged 78 Sam Neill’s 20 best roles Sam Neill’s friends, peers and admirers have rushed to pay tribute to the actor, after his sudden death on Monday at the age of 78. Australian director Phillip Noyce, who directed Neill in the 1989 thriller Dead Calm alongside Nicole Kidman, told the Guardian: “Sam was perhaps the most gentlemanly actor ​I ever encountered. Level-headed and sincere in a show business world of crazy egos. His word was his contract.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 这位出演过 100 多部电影的明星被誉为新西兰艺术、文化和环境的捍卫者，也是一位慷慨的合作者和朋友，《侏罗纪公园》电影和《钢琴》的主演山姆·尼尔 (Sam Neill) 去世，享年 78 岁。 山姆·尼尔 (Sam Neill) 饰演的 20 个最佳角色 山姆·尼尔 (Sam Neill) 于周一突然去世，享年 78 岁，他的朋友、同辈和仰慕者纷纷向他致敬。 澳大利亚导演菲利普·诺伊斯 (Phillip Noyce) 曾执导《尼尔》 1989 年与妮可·基德曼合作的惊悚片《死寂》告诉《卫报》：“山姆可能是我遇到过的最绅士的演员。在一个疯狂自负的演艺界中，他头脑冷静、真诚。他的话就是他的合同。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: Sam Neill's passing prompts reflection on a life lived with integrity and generosity, as evidenced by the heartfelt tributes. The many remembrances highlight a career marked by dedication and a character cherished for kindness and significant contributions. This reminds us of the enduring value of finishing our own race well, leaving a legacy of good deeds...
reflection.zh: 萨姆·尼尔的逝世引发了人们对一个充满正直和慷慨的人生进行反思，这从真挚的悼词中可见一斑。众多缅怀之辞强调了他职业生涯中的奉献精神，以及他因善良和重大贡献而被人珍视的品格。这提醒我们，圆满跑完自己的人生赛程，留下善行和积极影响的遗产，具有持久的价值。

verse.textEn: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verse.textZh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。

title.en: More than 120 families contacted as police investigate alleged abuse by Sydney childcare worker
title.zh: 悉尼托儿所工作人员涉嫌虐待儿童，警方已联系120多个家庭进行调查

summary.en: Police in Sydney are investigating a childcare worker for alleged abuse, with over 120 families contacted and 136 victims identified over a 16-year period.
summary.zh: 悉尼警方正在调查一名托儿所工作人员涉嫌虐待儿童的案件，目前已联系了120多个家庭，并在长达16年的时间里确认了136名受害者。

body.en: Police allege there are 136 victims of the man’s offending, which allegedly took place over a 16-year period Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia federal police have contacted more than 120 families as they investigate alleged offending by a former Sydney childcare worker. The man, 35, has been charged with 329 offences allegedly committed over a 16-year period against 136 victims. Continue reading...
body.zh: 警方称，该男子的犯罪行为据称发生了 16 年，共有 136 名受害者。 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客，了解最新动态 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 澳大利亚联邦警察在调查一名前悉尼儿童保育员涉嫌犯罪行为时，已联系了 120 多个家庭。这名 35 岁的男子被指控在 16 年内对 136 名受害者犯下 329 项罪行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This heartbreaking news reminds us of the profound vulnerability of children and the sacred trust placed in those who care for them. Yahweh's word warns severely against causing harm to the innocent, underscoring our collective responsibility to protect the youngest among us. May justice prevail and healing begin for all affected families.
reflection.zh: 这令人心碎的消息提醒我们儿童的极度脆弱性，以及对那些照看他们的人所寄予的神圣信任。雅伟的话语严厉警告不可伤害无辜者，强调了我们保护最年幼者的集体责任。愿正义得以伸张，所有受影响的家庭都能开始疗愈。

verse.textEn: If anyone causes one of these little ones — those who believe in me — to stumble, it would be better for them to have a large millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
verse.textZh: 凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，沉在深海里。
verse.themeEn: Woe to those who harm children

title.en: Afternoon Update: Sam Neill dies aged 78; Jewish academic subjected to Nazi salutes; and a growing garbage mountain
title.zh: 下午更新：山姆·尼尔去世，享年78岁；犹太学者遭纳粹敬礼；垃圾山日益增长

summary.en: The afternoon update reported the death of New Zealand actor Sam Neill at 78, an incident where a Jewish academic was subjected to Nazi salutes, and an ongoing issue of a growing garbage mountain.

title.en: 'You've got no choice': The $1,475 fee leaving some in Australia feeling 'captive'
title.zh: “你别无选择”：1475澳元的费用让一些澳大利亚人感到“受困”

summary.en: A significant increase in visa fees in Australia is causing distress, as it transforms the ability to travel and return home into an expensive, unavoidable requirement for some individuals.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚签证费大幅上涨，导致一些人感到困扰，因为这使得旅行和回家的权利变成了一项昂贵且无法避免的义务。

body.en:
Richard Whitten's wife, Yoona, has lived in Australia for nine years — but she still pays a premium to travel outside the country.

On 1 July, the Australian government increased fees across a slew of visa categories overnight, with little warning.

The visa Yoona needs just to travel — the Resident Return Visa — saw one of the steepest increases of all: hiked from $490 to $1,475, a 201 per cent rise.

"Every five years, we'll have to pay that if she wants to travel. It's a pretty heavy cost," Richard told SBS News.

"Everything's gotten more expensive. Our mortgage has gone up, bills, groceries, daycare fees, everything. Then suddenly it's an extra $1,500 that we have to pay."

Despite living in Melbourne as a permanent resident, Yoona can't become an Australian citizen without giving up her South Korean citizenship — something she isn't willing to do.

That leaves her locked into paying the Resident Return Visa fee indefinitely, just to retain the right to leave the country and come back.

Those affected have said the changes are "unfair" — with one migration agent warning the people most affected will be those from poorer countries.

Most visa application fees rose by around 25 per cent on 1 July. But a handful of visas were hit far harder.

The Resident Return Visa saw a 201 per cent increase, while the Bridging Visa B rose from $190 to $575 — a 202 per cent increase.

Student visas will rise from $2,000 to $2,500, while temporary graduate visa fees have increased twice — from $2,300 to $4,600 in March and now to $5,750.

A Home Affairs spokesperson said that increases were intended to help ensure Australia's migration system "operates in the national interest", with revenue from the changes supporting "this reform and other government priorities".

"The cost of visas remains a small proportion of the overall costs of visiting or migrating to Australia," they said.

For people like Richard and Yoona, the change adds stress to an already prevalent cost of living crisis.

Whitten says it could motivate his wife to pursue citizenship since she'd no longer have to pay the fee — that framing overlooks people like her who cannot hold dual citizenship.

"Her South Korean citizenship is too important to her," he said. "It's just something we have to pay."

He says friends in Melbourne's South Korean community — including couples where both partners hold permanent residency — are now facing a bill of just under $3,000 every five years simply to travel home and back.

reflection.en: When essential travel becomes an unavoidable financial burden, it can feel like an oppressive obligation. Yahweh's word reminds us that heavy financial demands can make individuals feel bound, highlighting the importance of policies that do not unduly burden people.

title.en: 'Immeasurable loss': Actor Sam Neill dies at 78
title.zh: “无法估量的损失”：演员萨姆·尼尔去世，享年78岁

summary.en: The iconic New Zealand actor's family said the loss was "sudden and unexpected".
summary.zh: 这位标志性的新西兰演员的家人表示，他的离世“突然且出乎意料”，是“无法估量的损失”。

body.en:
The Jurassic Park star's family announced the news on Instagram, saying he died on Monday in Sydney.

"Sam was surrounded by family and passed with the dignity that has characterised his whole life," the statement said.

"The loss was sudden and unexpected but blessed by the fact that Sam remained cancer free.

"They would like to express their deepest gratitude to the staff at St Vincent’s Private Hospital for their incredible care.

"More details will be shared later, but for now, on behalf of the family, we ask that you respect their privacy as they navigate this immeasurable loss."

Neill announced he was being treated for stage-three angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma in his 2023 memoir, Did I Ever Tell You This?

In late April this year, he announced he was cancer-free after undergoing trial treatment when chemotherapy stopped working on the stage-three blood cancer.

"I’ve been living with a particular type of lymphoma for about five years and I was on chemotherapy," he told 7News at the time. "Pretty miserable business but it was keeping me alive."

He said he was "very, very excited" to be cancer-free, adding, "it's time I did another movie".

Responding to the news of Neill's death , Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said Neill had starred in "so many beloved Australian stories and he earned a special place in Australian hearts".

"Wry and dry, thoughtful and laconic, Sam fought illness with the same dignity, humour and conviction that gave strength to his every performance," he said.

The actor's career spanned five decades, and included turns in The Piano, Thor: Love and Thunder, The Dish and Peter Rabbit. He also appeared in the popular British period drama series Peaky Blinders.

He was perhaps best known for his portrayal of Dr Alan Grant in the Jurassic Park movies.

Speaking to ABC's Australian Story about his cancer in 2023, Neill said he was "not remotely afraid" of death, but it would be "annoying" because he has more to do.

"It's out of my control. If you can't control it, don't get into it," he said of cancer.

reflection.en: The news of Sam Neill's sudden passing reminds us of the universal truth that "it is appointed for man to die once." While his loss is deeply felt, this reality calls us to reflect on the preciousness of each life and the legacy we leave behind.
reflection.zh: 萨姆·尼尔突然离世的消息提醒我们，人“死是人人注定的”这一普遍真理。虽然他的离去令人深感悲痛，但这一现实也促使我们反思生命的宝贵和我们所留下的遗产。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Auction clearance rates have climbed — but there's a 'brutal reality' behind the bounce
title.zh: 拍卖清盘率有所攀升——但繁荣背后隐藏着一个“残酷的现实”

summary.en: Recent auction figures initially appear positive, showing a climb in clearance rates. However, experts caution that these numbers do not reveal the full picture, indicating a more challenging underlying reality.
summary.zh: 最新的拍卖数据初看令人鼓舞，显示清盘率有所攀升。然而，专家警告说，这些数字只反映了部分情况，其背后隐藏着一个更为严峻的现实。

body.en:
Auction clearance rates have climbed back above 50 per cent after reaching their lowest level in more than six years, but analysts caution the rebound may reflect a drop in the number of properties going under the hammer rather than a broader market recovery.

The preliminary auction clearance rate across the combined Australian capital cities rose to 54.8 per cent last week, up five percentage points from the previous week and the highest level in seven weeks, according to property research firm Cotality.

It follows a low point in late June, when just 47.4 per cent of almost 1,900 homes taken to auction were sold — the weakest rate since April 2020, when the COVID-19 pandemic disrupted the housing market.

Industry figures say fewer listings, more realistic seller expectations and fewer properties competing for buyers can push clearance rates higher even while broader market conditions remain soft.
